directions.title: Google Ads
directions.reason: En «What can a well-managed Search campaign offer?», después de su párrafo sobre complementar SEO: “If you are deciding which work to fund first, compare [SEO and Search ads against your next business need](https://rankingrebels.com/blog/seo-or-google-ads-budget/), including shared costs and review conditions.” Privado hasta que ambos destinos sean públicos.

directions.title: Marketing measurement
directions.reason: En «Compare combined business outcomes without double counting», tras el párrafo de reconciliar resultados únicos: “For a wider review, use our guide to [checking whether digital marketing is working](https://rankingrebels.com/blog/measure-digital-marketing-results/) to keep business records, attributed credit and causal claims separate.” Privado hasta publicar 11.

directions.title: Marketing measurement
directions.reason: La guía 11 evalúa marketing existente. No exige escoger SEO/Ads y ya ofrece el marco de evidencia; no forzar reciprocidad.
